newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gold Fields, Anglo still in talks.
newsitem.headline: Gold Fields, Anglo still in talks.

text.p: Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd said on Monday it was still in talks with Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd on a possible tie-up between Deelkraal Gold Mining Co Ltd and Anglo's Elandsrand gold mine.
The two mining houses issued a cautionary annoucement in August advising shareholders of the talks on the possible tie-up between Deelkraal and Elandsrand Gold Mining Co Ltd.
Keith Spencer, Gold Fields general manager of gold operations, told a results presentation that talks were still continuing with Anglo.
"We have issued further joint cautionary announcements with Anglo American on the future of Deelkraal and right now we have little further to add those statements," Spencer said.
The neighbouring mines said in August that the target was realising benefits which could be achieved through joint action.
